en.io: Input: project git metadata and .hyperflow files. Output: a read-only status block with static project fields and optional feature/task progress sections.
en.boundary: Never modifies state or dispatches work. Missing or malformed inputs degrade to placeholders or checkbox counts. ETA is a simple extrapolation and is omitted or marked untracked when required timestamps or progress data are absent.
dependencies: Readable git metadata for version reporting
Readable .hyperflow profile, memory, task, and feature files
Standard shell utilities such as ls, stat, date, grep, sed, cut, head, and awk
scenarios: Resume work and inspect in-flight tasks.
Check whether project analysis is stale.
View task progress, token tracking, elapsed time, and ETA.

zh.io: 输入：项目 Git 元数据及 .hyperflow 文件。输出：只读状态块，包含静态项目字段及可选的功能和任务进度。
zh.boundary: 不修改状态，也不调度工作。输入缺失或格式异常时降级为占位值或复选框计数；ETA 只是简单外推，缺少时间或进度数据时会标为未跟踪。
dependencies: 用于版本展示的可读 Git 元数据
可读的 .hyperflow 配置、记忆、任务和功能文件
scenarios: 恢复工作时查看进行中的任务。
检查项目分析是否过期。
查看任务进度、token、耗时和 ETA。
